title: Airport Crisis: Flight 472 Emergency
synopsis: During the pre-departure rush for Flight SW 472 to New York at SkyWays International Terminal 1, a $3.5M high-value consignment of industrial diamonds is stolen via an insider luggage swap. An identical blue hard-shell suitcase with a duplicated tag (#SKW-78921-472) was abandoned at Gate B07 as an unattended decoy to trigger a sterile zone security hold, while the authentic diamond-laden suitcase was covertly intercepted on Apron Bay 3 and diverted into an airport maintenance cart. A 3-agent relay team must extract visual forensic evidence from CCTV cameras, baggage scanner telemetry, staff access logs, incident reports, torn drop notes, and baggage tag reprint audits to unmask the insider culprit, prove the luggage swap method, and intercept the stolen diamonds before departure clearance.
dossier_text:
INCIDENT DOSSIER - SKYWAYS INTERNATIONAL AIRPORT
Date: 12 Nov 2024 | Location: Terminal 1, Gate B07 & Apron Bay 3 | Incident Ref: #OPS-SEC-472
Investigating Desk: Airport Security Intelligence & Anti-Contraband Taskforce

OVERVIEW:
Visual evidence, digital telemetry, physical crime scene artifacts, and administrative logs have been assembled concerning the pre-departure theft and baggage swap affecting Flight SW 472 bound for New York.

COLLECTION OF MULTI-SOURCE VISUAL EVIDENCE:
1. CCTV Feed [CAM 03 - Check-in Area A] (Timestamp: 2024-11-12 08:14:23)
2. CCTV Feed [CAM 12 - Gate B07 Corridor] (Timestamp: 2024-11-12 08:47:10)
3. CCTV Feed [CAM 21 - Baggage Bay Area / Apron Stand B07] (Timestamp: 2024-11-12 09:02:55)
4. Flight Information Display System & Consignment Telemetry (Timestamp: 12 Nov 2024 08:30)
5. Passenger WhatsApp Chat Screenshot [Passenger Aarav Mehta] (Timestamps: 08:35 - 08:47)
6. Security Observation & Portable X-Ray Report #SEC-0849 (Timestamp: 12 Nov 2024 08:49)
7. Concourse Blueprint Drawing & Electronic Door Log [Door B-Staff-03] (Timestamp: 08:47:45)
8. Physical Evidence Recovered at Gate B07 (Torn Drop Note & Ramp Dispatch Comparison)
9. Baggage Tag Forensic Audit [Decoy Bag Barcode Tag #SKW-78921-472]
10. Decoy / Irrelevant Peripheral Material (Daily Chronicle Marathon article)

evidence_items.title: CCTV: Check-in Area A (Counter 04)
evidence_items.prompt_hint: Inspect the airline check-in transaction. Direct Agent 1 to read the visible camera timestamp (08:14:23), identify passenger Daniel Kim, extract the checked blue suitcase weight on the digital scale (18.4 kg), and note counter agent Priya Sharma (Badge SKY-412).
evidence_items.description: Passenger Daniel Kim checks in a blue polycarbonate suitcase at Counter A04 for Flight SW 472; digital scale confirms weight 18.4 kg; bag dispatched onto primary conveyor.
evidence_items.ocr_ledger:
FEED METADATA: Camera CAM 03 | Location: Terminal 1 Main Concourse, Check-in Island A, Counter 04 | Video Stream Sync: 2024-11-12 08:14:23 UTC+05:30.
VISUAL SUBJECTS: Ticket Agent Priya Sharma (ID badge: SKY-412) and Passenger Daniel Kim (wearing grey overcoat, passport in hand).
OBJECTS & ACTIONS: Passenger Daniel Kim places a medium blue hard-shell polycarbonate suitcase onto baggage belt scale. Scale display reads: 18.4 kg. SkyWays automated luggage tag generated and affixed. Passenger receives boarding pass for Flight SW 472, Seat 14A. Suitcase clears check-in scanner and is dispatched onto primary conveyor bay.
TELEMETRY NOTE: Adjacent supervisor terminal accessed by badge #RAMP-882 (Tariq Malik) at 08:16:05.

evidence_items.title: CCTV: Gate B07 Concourse Corridor
evidence_items.prompt_hint: Track the fleeing suspect. Direct Agent 1 to record the camera timestamp (08:47:10), describe the subject's dark hooded windbreaker, and crucially note their distinctive tarmac safety boots with orange high-visibility soles (Spec RAMP-882 footwear).
evidence_items.description: Suspect in dark hooded windbreaker walking briskly away from Gate B07 immediately after the blue bag was abandoned; footwear shows orange high-vis ramp safety soles.
evidence_items.ocr_ledger:
FEED METADATA: Camera CAM 12 | Location: Concourse B Passenger Corridor adjacent to Gate B07 | Timestamp: 2024-11-12 08:47:10.
VISUAL SUBJECTS: Individual of broad build wearing dark navy hooded windbreaker with hood drawn low, dark trousers, black work gloves, and distinct tarmac safety boots featuring bright orange high-visibility soles and steel toes (Spec RAMP-882 standard issue to Ramp Supervisors).
MOVEMENT DYNAMICS: Subject walks at rapid pace heading away from Gate B07 seating bay toward staff egress door B-Staff-03. Leaves Gate B07 seating area with empty hands after abandoning the blue suitcase at 08:46.

evidence_items.title: CCTV: Sub-Terminal Apron Bay 3 & Maintenance Cart
evidence_items.prompt_hint: Examine ground apron operations. Direct Agent 1 to observe Ramp Supervisor Tariq Malik directing cargo loading, spot yellow maintenance utility cart #MC-08 parked beside the conveyor, and detect the genuine blue 18.4 kg suitcase being diverted into Cart #MC-08.
evidence_items.description: Ramp crew active at Aircraft Stand B07; yellow maintenance cart #MC-08 parked near conveyor belt with an authentic blue hard-shell suitcase diverted away from the aircraft cargo hold.
evidence_items.ocr_ledger:
FEED METADATA: Camera CAM 21 | Location: Sub-terminal Apron Bay 3, Aircraft Stand B07 Ground Level | Timestamp: 2024-11-12 09:02:55.
OPERATIONAL OBSERVATIONS: Ramp crew loading containerized cargo onto Flight SW 472. Parked adjacent to the belt conveyor is yellow airport maintenance utility cart #MC-08. Surveillance captures Ramp Supervisor Tariq Malik (RAMP-882) covertly lifting the authentic blue hard-shell suitcase (18.4 kg diamond shipment) from the apron belt and stowing it under a tarpaulin inside Maintenance Cart #MC-08, instead of the aircraft cargo container.

evidence_items.title: Security Observation & Portable X-Ray Report #SEC-0849
evidence_items.prompt_hint: Transcribe Officer R. Nair's official security log and portable X-ray scan. Direct Agent 1 to extract the logged weight of the gate bag (12.1 kg vs 18.4 kg at check-in), the X-ray contents (dense sand ballast, no clothing/valuables), confirming it is a decoy bag.
evidence_items.description: Officer R. Nair logs unattended blue suitcase at Gate B07. Portable security scale logs weight at 12.1 kg (6.3 kg discrepancy from 18.4 kg check-in). X-ray reveals only dense ballast, confirming decoy swap.
evidence_items.ocr_ledger:
INCIDENT REPORT OCR TRANSCRIPTION: SkyWays Aviation Security Patrol Incident Slip #SEC-0849
Date: 12-Nov-2024 | Time Logged: 08:49:00 | Reporting Officer: R. Nair (Badge #AVSEC-9042)
Incident Location: Terminal 1, Departure Gate B07, Window Seating Bay (Row 4)
Physical Item: Blue hard-shell wheeled suitcase bearing Tag #SKW-78921-472.
FORENSIC MEASUREMENTS: Portable security scale reads: 12.1 kg (Check-in ledger shows 18.4 kg; Discrepancy: -6.3 kg).
PORTABLE BACKSCATTER X-RAY: Interior reveals 6 packets of dense construction sand and gravel ballast. Completely empty of passenger garments, toiletries, or personal effects. Conclusive proof that the gate suitcase is a planted decoy designed to trigger an evacuation/hold.

operational_rules: Rule SEC-101 (Sterile Zone Unattended Baggage Protocol): Any unattended baggage detected in passenger departure/boarding gates must be immediately cordoned off and subjected to certified explosive detection / K9 unit inspection.

Rule BAGG-204 (Baggage Chain-of-Custody & Tag Duplicate Protocol): Manual reprinting or duplication of automated baggage tags requires multi-factor supervisor authorization; any weight discrepancy exceeding 1.0 kg between check-in scale telemetry and gate intercept flags an immediate chain-of-custody fraud alarm.

Rule OPS-204 (Pre-Departure Security Hold Protocol): No commercial flight assigned to a gate under an unresolved security investigation, unattended baggage incident, or ramp cargo diversion may push back, board passengers, or be cleared for departure until authorized by the Security Director.
